To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
TOR controls biomass accumulation and cell growth by redirecting carbon and nitrogen metabolism in a highly synchronized alga.
TOR controls growth by regulating the balance between carbon and nitrogen metabolism.
TOR is a central regulator of carbon and nitrogen allocation and hence biomass accumulation and cell growth in C. reinhardtii.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the elucidation of molecular and physiological processes of the TOR signaling pathway in a photosynthetic eukaryotic organism.

the molecular mechanisms of growth control and cell cycle progression in a model organism, which is of general importance for the development of photosynthetic microalgae as a renewable source of biomass for the production of biofuels and high-value compounds.
a detailed characterization of TOR-dependent growth control in a photosynthetic organism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TOR kinase controls the cell cycle by regulating metabolic processes, which are essential to maintain the carbon to nitrogen ratio in the cell.
TOR is a key regulator of carbon/nitrogen allocation in C. reinhardtii, which is responsible to maintain the balance between anabolic and metabolic processes, and hence biomass production.
TOR is an integrator of carbon and nitrogen metabolism in photosynthetic eukaryotes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TOR kinase is not just a nutrient-sensing protein, but rather an important regulator of the cell cycle and cell division.
TOR is a central regulator for the coordination of metabolic processes and cell cycle progression in photosynthetic eukaryotes.

the TOR complex is a central player in the control of the carbon to nitrogen ratio, which is responsible to regulate the growth rate, the cell cycle progression and the biomass accumulation in Chlamydomonads.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TOR kinase plays a central role in regulating the carbon to nitrogen allocation, which controls growth and cell division.
the TOR kinase plays a key role in the control of the carbon and nitrogen balance in C. reinhardtii, which is essential for biomass accumulation and growth.
the TOR kinase is not only a central regulator of cell growth, but also of the carbon to nitrogen allocation in C. reinhardtii.
